_comment: Curated demo scenes offered by GET /api/scenes/local (audit N-14).
The UI used to hardcode contracts/mocks/scene_meta.json, so every run
launched from the browser was a 1-of-5-real smoke test. This catalog is
the honest replacement: the default is a genuine Sentinel-1 acquisition,
and every entry carries the caveats that apply to it.
sentinel1_real  - a real Sentinel-1 product; acquired_utc comes from the
product identifier, so the timestamp is measured.
corpus_heldout  - real SAR from the Trujillo corpus, in the held-out test
split (the deployed segmenter never trained on it).
corpus_train    - real SAR from the Trujillo corpus, but NOT held out;
the segmenter was trained on it, so detection
confidence on this scene is not evidence of accuracy.
mock            - synthetic raster for pipeline smoke tests only.
Corpus scenes carry no acquisition metadata (the rasters hold only
AREA_OR_POINT, and the Zenodo records are file manifests), so their
acquired_utc was ASSIGNED for the demo, not measured. That is declared
per entry via time_basis and must reach the UI: the hindcast integrates
backward from this timestamp, so it anchors the whole temporal chain.

scenes.label: Chennai / Ennore, India
scenes.notes: Real Sentinel-1A IW GRDH acquisition. acquired_utc is read from the product identifier (20170129T003132). Full-resolution 28072 x 21162 scene.

scenes.label: Eastern Mediterranean (held-out)
scenes.notes: Trujillo Part III scene Oil/00000, present in the held-out test split.

scenes.label: Persian Gulf (held-out)
scenes.notes: Trujillo Part III scene Oil/00035, present in the held-out test split.

scenes.label: Sumatra (held-out)
scenes.notes: Trujillo Part III scene Oil/00055, present in the held-out test split.

scenes.label: Java Sea (held-out)
scenes.notes: Trujillo Part III scene Oil/00081, present in the held-out test split.

scenes.label: Bali Strait, Indonesia
scenes.notes: Trujillo Part III scene Oil/00074. NOT in the held-out test split, so the segmenter trained on it. Retained because existing sealed runs reference it; never cite its confidence as accuracy evidence.

scenes.label: Mock raster (pipeline smoke test)
scenes.notes: Synthetic raster with no oil. Produces a 1-of-5-real run by design; useful only for exercising the pipeline wiring.
